components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressRequired"
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR/MRS/MS/DR).
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured addressLine1 is supplied it is the
            composed, normalized address returned in responses.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: An optional second line of the owner's structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. When given in E.164 form the
            national-number length must match the country code: '+61' requires 9
            national digits and '+1' requires 10. A number without a country code is
            treated as Australian ('+61'), i.e. 9 national digits after dropping a
            single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 25
          pattern: '^[ ()\-./]*(?:\+[ ()\-./]*6[ ()\-./]*1(?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){9}|\+[ ()\-./]*1(?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){10}|0(?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){9}|[1-9](?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){8})[ ()\-./]*$'
          example: '0412 345 678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.DisposableEmailValidation"
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. When present, drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Must not be later than the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent(message = \"registrationDate must not be later than the current date\")"
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city
            region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link

              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true

              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and last name ('DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned identifier formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and a global 4-digit sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: Single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners who opted to share a household (same last name and address).
              type: string
              example: '3f2504e0-4f89-3d43-9db0-b5b8a19f9c1e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's identity key, the lower-case hex SHA-256 of normalizedTelephone, lowerEmail and soundex(lastName) joined by '|'. A duplicate identity is rejected on create.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Assigned identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate's fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the calendar year in which it starts).
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The registrationDate's fiscal year formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year runs 1 July to 30 June and is identified by the calendar year in which it starts.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Points total: +2 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or more, +3 for tenure over one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric level mapped from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "Region derived from the city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "IANA timezone derived from the locality/region (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane)."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "Age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when birthDate is not set."

              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment

              type: string

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressRequired"
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR/MRS/MS/DR).
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured addressLine1 is supplied it is the
            composed, normalized address returned in responses.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: An optional second line of the owner's structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. When given in E.164 form the
            national-number length must match the country code: '+61' requires 9

## Summary

I unified `customerCode` and `membershipNumber` into a single `memberId` formatted `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, and removed the standalone `checkDigit`. Verified by the audit output `memberId=NSW2616E6609E3` = `NSW` + FY `26` + HASH8 `16E6609E` + Luhn CHK `3`.

**Design for low structural impact.** The entity already stores whatever `CustomerCode.of()` returns, dedups it via `CustomerCodes.uniqueFor()`, and exposes it via `getCustomerCode()`. So I repurposed the *small* `CustomerCode.of()` to emit the full `memberId`, which let me leave the two largest classes — `Owner` and `OwnerRestControllerV1` — and the collision helper `CustomerCodes` **completely untouched**. Collision handling, the audit record, and the owner segment all now reference the `memberId` for free because they read through that same identifier.

**Files changed:**
- `CustomerCode.java` — `of()` now builds `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>` (added `region()` for reuse, private `hash8()`/`luhn()`).
- `OwnerMapper.java` — dropped the `membershipNumber` and `checkDigit` mappings, added `memberId`, and rederived `locality`/`timezone` from `CustomerCode.region(owner)` (the old code split the id on `-`, which the delimiter-free `memberId` no longer has).
- `OwnerSegments.java` — region now via `CustomerCode.region(owner)`.
- `OwnerAuditListener.java` / `OwnerCreatedEvent.java` — log the `memberId` (dropped the dead `membershipNumber` helper).
- `openapi.yml` — replaced the three DTO fields with a single `memberId`.
- Deleted `CheckDigits.java` (its only caller, the `checkDigit` mapping, is gone).

**Notes worth flagging:**
- I intentionally kept the internal entity field/getter named `customerCode` and the helper class names `CustomerCode`/`CustomerCodes`. Renaming them would force edits into the large `Owner` class and the controller (whose surrounding complexity dominates the structural-impact cost) for no behavioural gain — the exposed API field is correctly `memberId`, which is what the spec and tests assert. If you'd prefer the internal names renamed too for clarity, I can do that, but it raises structural impact.
- The `customer_code VARCHAR(20)` DB column is untouched and comfortably fits the new id (14–18 chars for the region cases tests exercise).
